sources.snippet: It is used to instantiate a Swin model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the microsoft/swin-tiny-patch4-window7-224 Configuration objects inherit from PreTrainedConfig and can be used to control the model outputs.
